description: anime.js, loaded from the address scorsese ships it at (https://lib.scorsese/anime.min.js), lifts three pink squares and turns them half over, each 200 ms after the one before. At frame 0 all three sit low; at frame 15 the first is nearly at the top, the second halfway and the third just under way; at frame 29 all three are up. Squares that never move mean the library did not load (it would also be a warning on the render) or never saw the clock start, which anime.js reads as a frame timestamp above zero.
